name: slide-editor
description: HTML slide editor and player with first-class video support

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && electron-vite build && npm run build:export
scripts.build:importer: python3 -m venv .venv-import && ./.venv-import/bin/pip install -q keynote-parser pyinstaller && ./.venv-import/bin/pyinstaller --onefile --name keynote-import --collect-all keynote_parser --collect-all snappy --distpath build/importers --workpath build/pyinstaller --specpath build/pyinstaller importers/keynote/import_keynote.py
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:importer && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:importer && electron-builder --linux
scripts.export: npm run build:export >/dev/null && vite-node --config vitest.config.ts scripts/export-deck.mts --
